quote: earmarked $470 million under the New Energy Transport Fund to subsidise franchised bus operators in purchasing about 600 electric buses
note: 预算案列明在新能源运输基金下预留 4.7 亿港元，用于资助专营巴士营办商购置约 600 辆电动巴士。实际拨付金额待核查。

quote: the Fund has launched under the AU the Electric Bus Subsidy Scheme to subsidise franchised bus operators to purchase e-FBs
note: 环境及生态局网页确认新能源运输基金已推出电动巴士资助计划。

quote: commenced preparations for the tendering exercises to procure about 600 e-buses by end-2027
note: 政府向立法会披露，专营巴士营办商已展开招标准备。2027 年底为订购目标，订单或中标记录待核查。
